### FAQs | Sparkline Electrical Leeds
URL: https://chat-demo.tradesites.ai/faq

Sparkline Electrical

#### Frequently asked questions

#### How much does a rewire cost?

It depends on the size of the property and what's needed, so we quote in writing after a short visit. Quotes are free.

#### How quickly can you start?

Small jobs are often booked within a week. Rewires are usually booked 2 to 4 weeks ahead. We confirm a date when we quote.

#### Do you offer emergency call-outs?

No, we don't offer a 24-hour emergency service. If you have a dangerous fault, turn off the power at the consumer unit and call your network operator on 105 if there's a power cut.

#### Are you NICEIC registered?

Yes. We're an NICEIC approved contractor, so all notifiable work is certified and registered with building control.

#### Is your work guaranteed?

Yes, all our work comes with a 12-month workmanship guarantee, plus the manufacturers' warranties on parts.

#### What are your opening hours?

Monday to Friday 8am to 6pm, and Saturday 9am to 1pm.

#### How do I pay?

By bank transfer or card. For larger jobs we take a deposit when booking and the balance on completion.

#### Privacy notice

This is a demo site. This notice shows the kind of information a real business would give.

#### What we collect

If you send an enquiry or use the chat, we keep your name, contact details, the details of your job and the conversation, so we can reply and quote.

#### The chat assistant

The chat on this site is an AI assistant. It answers from the information on this website. Your messages are processed by our chat provider to generate replies. Your details are only sent to us after you confirm them in the chat.

#### How long we keep it

We keep enquiries for up to 2 years unless you become a customer, then as long as needed for guarantees and legal records.

#### Your rights

You can ask to see, correct or delete your details at any time by contacting us.

### Electrical services | Sparkline Electrical Leeds
URL: https://chat-demo.tradesites.ai/services

Sparkline Electrical

#### Our electrical services

Everything is certified to BS 7671 and covered by our 12-month workmanship guarantee.

#### Rewires

Full or partial rewires for homes and small commercial units. A 3-bed house usually takes 3 to 5 working days. We can work around you if you're living in the property.

#### Consumer unit (fuse box) upgrades

Modern RCBO boards with surge protection, usually installed in one day with the power off for around 4 to 6 hours.

#### EV charger installation

7kW smart chargers (Zappi, Ohme, Easee). We check your supply, fit the charger and handle the notification to the network operator.

#### EICRs and landlord safety certificates

Condition reports for homeowners, buyers and landlords. Landlords in England need an EICR at least every 5 years. Reports are sent within 48 hours.

#### Lighting, sockets and fault finding

Extra sockets, outdoor power, downlights, garden lighting, and tracing tripping circuits or faults.

#### What we don't do

We don't do gas or heating work, alarm monitoring, or 24-hour emergency call-outs. Large commercial or industrial projects are referred to partners.

#### Prices

Every job is different, so we quote in writing after a short visit or video call. Quotes are free and there's no obligation.
